headline: The Creation of Sierra del Divisor National Park Is Now Under Prime Ministry's Consideration
subheadline: Indigenous People Urge President Humala for Swift Action
content: Yesterday, the Council of Ministers approved the technical proposal to designate the area reserved Sierra del Divisor as a national park. This news was announced through Twitter by Gabriel Quishpay, Vice-Minister of Strategic Development of Natural Resources at the Environment Ministry. Located between Ucayali and Loreto regions, covering over 1.4 million hectares, Sierra del Divisor has been designated since 2006 yet remains protected. It hosts unique mountain chains within Peru and faces threats from illegal logging. Following its designation process, approval during next week’s Cabinet meeting could legally recognize it as a national park.

subheadline: EL PROBLEMA DEL NARCOTRAFICO EN LAS ALTAS ESFERAS
author: Alberto Otárola Peñaranda
content: En este artículo discutiremos si el Perú podría considerarse un narcoestado. Hablando específicamente sobre la situación actual bajo el mandato del presidente Ollanta Humala, hemos visto varios éxitos importantes en la lucha contra el narcotráfico. Entre ellas destaca la eliminación exitosa de grandes extensiones de plantaciones de hoja de coca ilegal y la incorporación de nuevas áreas a la frontera agrícola legal mediante proyectos de desarrollo integral.
